categories.heading: Tickets & Pricing
categories.description: Everything about ticket costs, discounts, and booking options.

questions.question: How much do Aquaverse tickets cost?
questions.answer:
Walk-in gate price is THB 1,595 (~$44 USD) per person. Online advance tickets start from THB 1,176 (~$24 USD), saving you up to ~27%. Children under 3 years old enter free. Online tickets include locker rental (worth THB 300).

View all ticket options and compare prices →

questions.question: How much are children's tickets at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Children under 3 years old enter free. Children aged 3–12 and seniors 65+ may receive a discounted gate price of THB 1,290 (vs THB 1,590 for adults). Online tickets typically use a single price for all ages 3+, starting from THB 1,176.

questions.question: Is it cheaper to buy tickets online or at the gate?
questions.answer:
Online tickets are significantly cheaper. Gate price is THB 1,595 while online prices start from THB 1,176 — that's up to ~27% off. Online tickets also include a free locker rental (worth THB 300) and instant mobile voucher confirmation. We strongly recommend booking online through platforms like Klook or KKday.

Compare online ticket deals →

questions.question: Is locker rental included with Aquaverse tickets?
questions.answer: Locker rental is included free with online advance tickets. If you buy tickets at the gate, locker rental costs an additional THB 300. Lockers are located near the entrance and can be accessed unlimited times throughout the day using your RFID wristband.

questions.question: Are there discounts or promotions for Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
Yes! The best discounts are available through online booking platforms:

  • Klook, KKday, Tiquets: Up to ~27% off gate price
  • Thai nationals: May receive special rates with valid Thai ID
  • Holiday promotions: Special deals during Songkran, New Year, and other holidays
  • Social media: Follow the park's Facebook and Instagram for flash sales

questions.question: Does Aquaverse offer group pricing?
questions.answer: Yes, group pricing is available for parties of 10 or more. Group bookings should be arranged directly through the park's sales team. School groups, corporate outings, and tour operators may receive additional discounts. Contact the park at +66 (0) 33 004 999 for group rate inquiries.

questions.question: How much does a cabana cost at Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
Cabana rental options: Deluxe THB 2,500/day, Super Deluxe THB 3,000/day, and VIP THB 3,500/day. Cabanas include shade, comfortable seating, towels, a personal attendant, and priority food service. Reservations are recommended, especially on weekends.

Read our cabana guide: is it worth it? →

questions.question: Can I get a refund on Aquaverse tickets?
questions.answer: Refund policies depend on where you purchased your tickets. Most online platforms (Klook, KKday) offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the visit date. Gate-purchased tickets are generally non-refundable. Always check the cancellation policy before booking.

categories.heading: Opening Hours & Schedule
categories.description: When the park is open, when it's closed, and when to visit.

questions.question: What are the opening hours of Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Aquaverse is open daily from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Rides close at 5:45 PM to allow for safe park closure. Last admission is at 3:30 PM. The park is closed every Wednesday for scheduled maintenance.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse closed on Wednesdays?
questions.answer: Yes. Columbia Pictures Aquaverse is closed every Wednesday for scheduled maintenance. This is the most common mistake tourists make — always double-check the day before heading to the park! The park operates normally on all other days (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday through Sunday).

questions.question: What time is last admission at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Last admission is at 3:30 PM. After this time, no new guests are admitted. All rides close at 5:45 PM, and the park gates close at 6:00 PM. We recommend arriving at 10 AM opening to maximize your time — a half-day visit starting at 3:30 PM is very short.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse open on Thai public holidays?
questions.answer: Yes, Aquaverse is generally open on Thai public holidays (except if the holiday falls on a Wednesday). Holiday periods like Songkran, New Year, and school holidays tend to be busier with potentially extended hours. Check the park's official Facebook page or call +66 (0) 33 004 999 for specific holiday schedules.

questions.question: When is the best time to visit Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
For the best experience:

  • Best day: Weekdays (Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri) are least crowded
  • Best season: November to April (dry season) has the best weather
  • Best arrival time: 10 AM at gate opening for shortest queues
  • Avoid: Weekends, Thai school holidays, and Songkran week

Read our detailed timing guide →

categories.heading: Getting There & Parking
categories.description: How to reach Aquaverse from Bangkok, Pattaya, and the airports.

questions.question: How do I get to Aquaverse from Bangkok?
questions.answer:
Multiple options available:

  • By car: 1.5–2 hours via Motorway Route 7 toward Pattaya (free parking at park)
  • By bus: From Ekkamai Bus Terminal (next to Ekkamai BTS), then taxi from Pattaya
  • By shared van: From Victory Monument or Ekkamai, ~THB 240/person
  • By Grab/taxi: THB 1,200–1,500 + tolls from Bangkok

See complete transportation guide →

questions.question: How do I get to Aquaverse from Pattaya?
questions.answer:
Aquaverse is about 30 minutes south of Pattaya city center in Na Jomtien:

  • By Grab/taxi: THB 300–500 from central Pattaya (20–30 min)
  • By songthaew: Take the Na Jomtien route (cheapest option)
  • Hotel transfer: Some hotels and tour operators arrange transfers for an extra charge — ask your reception

The park address is 888 Moo 8, Sukhumvit Road, Na Jomtien, Sattahip, Chon Buri 20250.

questions.question: Is there a shuttle bus to Aquaverse?
questions.answer: No, Aquaverse does not operate an official shuttle bus. The best option from Pattaya is Grab (THB 300–500, 20–30 minutes). Some hotels and tour operators offer private transfers for an extra charge. You can also take a songthaew to Na Jomtien and then a short Grab ride to the park.

questions.question: Is parking free at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Yes, parking is completely free for all guests. The car park is large with space for cars, vans, and tour buses. Motorcycle parking is also available. The parking area is located directly in front of the main entrance.

questions.question: How do I get to Aquaverse from the airports?
questions.answer:
• From Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK): 1.5–2 hours by car/taxi via Motorway Route 7, approximately THB 1,500–2,000
  • From U-Tapao Airport (UTP): Only 20–30 minutes by car/taxi, approximately THB 300–500. This is the closest airport to Aquaverse
  • From Don Mueang Airport (DMK): 2–2.5 hours by car/taxi, approximately THB 1,800–2,500

See complete airport transfer guide →

categories.heading: What to Bring & Wear
categories.description: Dress code, packing essentials, and prohibited items.

questions.question: What should I wear to Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
Proper swimwear is required for all water attractions:

  • Allowed: Swimsuits, bikinis, board shorts, rash guards, lycra activewear
  • Not allowed on slides: Clothing with buttons, zippers, or metal buckles; denim; loose jewelry
  • Recommended: Water shoes for walking between zones; cover-ups for restaurant areas

All guests must shower before entering water attractions.

Read full dress code guide →

questions.question: Can I bring my own towel to Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Yes, you can and should bring your own towel to save money. Towel rental is available at the park for an additional fee. A quick-dry microfiber towel is ideal as it packs small, dries fast, and takes up minimal locker space.

questions.question: Can I bring food and drinks into Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
No, outside food and beverages are not allowed inside the park. The only exceptions are:

  • Baby food and baby formula
  • Medically necessary dietary items
  • Sealed water bottles

The park has multiple restaurants and snack bars serving Thai and international food at reasonable prices (THB 100–350 per dish).

questions.question: How big are the lockers at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Standard lockers are large enough to fit a backpack, change of clothes, shoes, and personal items. They are located near the main entrance and can be accessed unlimited times throughout the day using your RFID wristband. Locker rental is free with online tickets or THB 300 at the gate.

questions.question: What items are prohibited at Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
The following items are not permitted inside the park:

  • Outside food and drinks (except baby food, sealed water)
  • Glass containers
  • Skateboards, scooters, rollerblades, hoverboards
  • Folding chairs and pop-up tents
  • Inflatable toys and beach balls
  • Sharp objects and weapons
  • Alcohol brought from outside
  • Drones
  • Professional photography/video equipment

GoPros and selfie sticks are not allowed on rides but are fine in walking areas.

See full prohibited items list →

categories.heading: Rides & Attractions
categories.description: Height restrictions, ride details, and what to expect.

questions.question: What are the height restrictions for rides?
questions.answer:
Height restrictions vary by ride:

  • Zombieland rides: 120 cm minimum
  • FlowRider surf simulator: 110 cm minimum
  • Hotel Transylvania kids zone: No height restriction
  • Wave pool & lazy river: No height restriction

Height measurement boards are posted at each ride entrance. Free life jackets are provided for children who don't meet requirements at certain attractions.

View all rides with height requirements →

questions.question: Can I ride alone (single rider) at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Most slides can be ridden solo. Some raft rides require 2–4 riders — in these cases, single riders are grouped with other guests. The FlowRider surf simulator is a solo experience. Check with ride attendants at each attraction for specific requirements.

questions.question: What is the age limit for go-karts at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Height and age restrictions apply for the Bad Boys go-kart experience. Go-karts are an add-on at THB 640 (not included in standard park admission).

questions.question: How difficult is the FlowRider at Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
The FlowRider surf simulator has two modes:

  • Bodyboarding (beginner-friendly): Most guests can do this on their first try. Just lie on the board and enjoy the ride.
  • Stand-up surfing (advanced): Requires balance and practice. Expect to fall a few times! Instructors are available to help.

No prior surfing experience is needed for bodyboarding. Minimum height is 110 cm. Queue times are typically 10–20 minutes.

questions.question: Which zones are best for young kids?
questions.answer:
The best zones for young children are:

  • Hotel Transylvania: SE Asia's largest kids' water playground with 9 kid-friendly slides, splash pads, dozens of water features, and character meet-and-greets
  • Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs: Gentle lazy river suitable for all ages
  • Mega Wave Pool: Shallow areas perfect for toddlers and young swimmers
  • The Emoji Movie: Mini golf and photo ops (dry activities)

Read our complete guide to Aquaverse with kids →

questions.question: Are there any non-water activities at Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
Yes! Aquaverse offers several dry attractions:

  • Bad Boys Go-Karts: Racing track (separate fee)
  • The Emoji Movie Mini Golf: 9-hole themed course
  • Onsen spa area: Japanese-style hot spring relaxation
  • Live shows & entertainment: At the Omnitheatre by the wave pool
  • Character meet-and-greets: Photo ops with movie characters
  • Themed gift shops: Movie merchandise and souvenirs

categories.heading: Food & Dining
categories.description: Restaurant options, dietary requirements, and the payment system.

questions.question: What restaurants are inside Aquaverse?
questions.answer:
Aquaverse has several dining options:

Aquaverse has several themed dining areas. The park uses a credit band system called Foodville for all purchases:

  • Food court: Burgers, grilled meats, Thai dishes, kids' meals. THB 80–350.
  • Thai food stalls: Rice bowls, Thai snacks, fried chicken. THB 80–350.
  • Bar area (Wave Pool area): Smoothies, juices, cocktails, light snacks. THB 80–200.
  • Snack carts & ice cream stands located throughout the park.

Read our food guide with recommendations →

questions.question: Is halal food available at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: While there is no dedicated halal-certified restaurant at Aquaverse, several food options are suitable for Muslim visitors including seafood, grilled chicken, and vegetable dishes. Staff can advise on ingredients. Pork items are clearly marked on menus. For strict halal requirements, consider eating at a halal-certified restaurant before arriving at the park.

questions.question: Are there vegetarian or vegan options?
questions.answer: Yes, vegetarian options are available at most food outlets, including veggie burgers, salads, rice dishes, fresh fruit, and Thai vegetable stir-fries. Vegan options are more limited but available upon request — ask staff for dairy-free and egg-free choices. The bar area offers fresh fruit smoothies and juices that are naturally vegan.

questions.question: How does the RFID payment system work?
questions.answer:
Upon entry, guests receive an RFID wristband that can be loaded with credit at top-up stations throughout the park:

  • Load credit using cash or credit card at kiosks near the entrance and food areas
  • Tap your wristband at all food stalls, shops, and optional activities to pay
  • Any unused balance is refunded at exit kiosks when you leave
  • The wristband also links to the park's automatic ride photo system

No need to carry a wallet around the park!

categories.heading: Facilities & Services
categories.description: WiFi, first aid, accessibility, and other park services.

questions.question: Is there free WiFi at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Yes, free WiFi is available throughout the park. However, speeds can be slow during peak hours with many users connected. For reliable connectivity, consider using your mobile data. We recommend downloading any maps or information you need before entering the park.

questions.question: Is there a first aid station at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Yes, a fully staffed first aid station is located near the main entrance. Trained staff can assist with minor injuries, sunburn, insect bites, heat-related issues, and other medical needs. For emergencies, the park has direct communication with local hospitals. Lifeguards are stationed at all water attractions throughout the park.

questions.question: What happens if I lose something at Aquaverse?
questions.answer: Report lost items to the Lost and Found desk located near the main entrance. Staff regularly collect items found throughout the park. For inquiries after your visit, call +66 (0) 33 004 999. To prevent loss, we strongly recommend using the lockers (free with online tickets) to store valuables rather than carrying them around the park.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse accessible for guests with disabilities?
questions.answer:
Aquaverse provides accessible features including:

  • Accessible pathways and ramps throughout most park areas
  • Accessible restrooms available
  • Wave pool viewing areas, restaurants, shows, and walking-area attractions are all accessible
  • Some water rides may have physical requirements that limit accessibility

Contact the park in advance at +66 (0) 33 004 999 for specific accessibility questions and to arrange any needed assistance.

questions.question: Can I re-enter the park after leaving?
questions.answer: Re-entry is generally not permitted once you exit the park. Make sure to bring everything you need inside. If you need to retrieve something from your car, speak with guest services at the exit — they may be able to arrange temporary re-entry on a case-by-case basis.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse suitable for elderly visitors or seniors?
questions.answer: Yes! Aquaverse is suitable for visitors of all ages. Seniors can enjoy the lazy river, wave pool viewing areas, live shows, restaurants, and shaded rest areas. The park has accessible pathways, and cabana rentals (from THB 2,500) provide a comfortable base with shade and seating. For a complete guide, read our Pattaya Seniors Guide.

questions.question: How does Aquaverse compare to Ramayana Water Park?
questions.answer: Both are excellent water parks in Pattaya but offer different experiences. Aquaverse features Hollywood movie-themed zones (Jumanji, Ghostbusters, Hotel Transylvania) and unique attractions like go-karts and FlowRider surfing. Ramayana is larger with more slides and a natural Thai-garden setting. Aquaverse is better for families with young kids and movie fans; Ramayana suits thrill-seekers wanting maximum slide variety. See our full Aquaverse vs Ramayana comparison.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse the same as Cartoon Network Amazone?
questions.answer: Yes. The park was originally called Cartoon Network Amazone (opened 2014). In 2021, it was rebranded to Columbia Pictures Aquaverse with all-new movie-themed zones based on Sony/Columbia Pictures franchises. The location (Na Jomtien, Sattahip) is the same, but the theming, attractions, and branding are completely different.

questions.question: Can I visit Aquaverse as a solo traveler?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Many visitors enjoy Aquaverse solo. The FlowRider, wave pool, lazy river, and go-karts are all enjoyable alone. Staff are friendly and the park is safe. It's a great way to spend a fun day in Pattaya. Check our Pattaya Solo Travel Guide for more tips.

questions.question: Is Aquaverse good for a couple's date?
questions.answer: Yes! Aquaverse makes for a fun and unique date. Couples love the FlowRider surfing challenge, the relaxing lazy river ride together, go-kart racing, and the themed photo spots. Consider upgrading to a cabana for a more private, romantic experience. See our Pattaya Couples Guide for a full romantic itinerary.

whyVisit.heading: Why Visit Aquaverse?
whyVisit.introText: Columbia Pictures Aquaverse is the world's first fully branded Columbia Pictures theme park, located in the heart of Pattaya's coastal area. Originally opened as Cartoon Network Amazone in 2014, the park was completely redesigned and relaunched in October 2022 with Sony Pictures IP. Visit the official Aquaverse website for the latest park announcements.

zones.heading: 9 Movie-Themed Zones
zones.description: Each zone brings a beloved Columbia Pictures movie to life with immersive theming, unique rides, and unforgettable experiences.

items.name: Hotel Transylvania Zone
items.description: Southeast Asia's largest branded aqua playground. 9 water slides, dozens of water features, and character meet-and-greets with Drac, Mavis, and Blobby.

items.name: Ghostbusters Zone
items.description: Home to the World's First Water Dome! Race through twists and turns in the dark on Ghostbusters floats, then plunge into the massive water dome.

items.name: Zombieland Zone
items.description: Features "The Beast" — one of Asia's tallest water slides with an 18-meter vertical drop! Also includes a 360-degree spin slide and mat racers.

items.name: Jumanji Zone
items.description: Enter the wild jungle! Conquer Jaguar Mountain, dodge the Viper slide, and survive the Jungle Stampede as mandrills chase you into the splash pool.

items.name: Surf's Up Zone
items.description: Ride the 40-foot FlowRider Double surf simulator with professional instruction. Additional fee required.

items.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
items.description: Float along the Swallow Falls River Adventure lazy river, surrounded by wacky Foodimals and food-themed experiences from the movie.

items.name: Bad Boys Race Club
items.description: Hit the track on a Miami-themed go-kart circuit! Custom-designed karts and drift bikes for an adrenaline-pumping racing experience.

items.name: The Emoji Movie Zone
items.description: A fun mini-golf course with creative obstacles inspired by The Emoji Movie. Compete with friends and family for prizes!

items.name: Mega Wave Pool Omnitheatre
items.description: The centerpiece of Aquaverse! Mega waves every 20 minutes, foam parties, outdoor movie screenings, live concerts with Dolby DTS surround sound.

items.question: Can I bring food to Aquaverse?
items.answer:
No, outside food and beverages are not allowed (exception: baby food/formula). The park has multiple dining options:

  • Food Court — Burgers, BBQ, and international dishes
  • Thai Food Stalls — Local Thai favourites
  • Snack Bars — Quick bites and chicken dishes
  • Bar Area — Cocktails and drinks

Tip: The park uses a cashless RFID wristband system — load credit and spend without carrying cash.

items.question: Is Aquaverse or Ramayana Water Park better?
items.answer:
Both are excellent, but they offer different experiences:

  • Choose Aquaverse if: You want Hollywood movie theming, variety of activities (water + go-karts + mini golf + onsen), and are visiting with young kids who love the movie characters
  • Choose Ramayana if: You want the biggest water park with the most slides, better value for pure water park fun, and a more relaxing day

items.question: When is the best time to visit Aquaverse?
items.answer:
Best season: November to April (dry season) for the best weather.

Best day: Weekdays are significantly less crowded than weekends. Avoid Wednesdays (park closed).

Best time: Arrive at 10 AM when the park opens to beat the crowds and maximize your day.

nearby.heading: Things to Do Near Aquaverse
nearby.description: Make the most of your Pattaya trip with these popular attractions near Aquaverse.

cards.heading: Nong Nooch Tropical Garden
cards.text: Stunning tropical botanical garden with cultural shows. Just 10 minutes from Aquaverse.

cards.heading: Buddha Mountain (Khao Chi Chan)
cards.text: Impressive 130-meter golden Buddha laser-carved into a cliff face. 15 minutes away.

cards.heading: Jomtien Beach
cards.text: One of Pattaya's most popular beaches with water sports, restaurants, and nightlife. 20 minutes north.

cards.heading: Pattaya Elephant Sanctuary
cards.text: Ethical elephant sanctuary where you can feed and walk with rescued elephants. 25 minutes away.
